name: dsh-local-delegate
description: Delegates mechanical text work (translate, summarize, extract, classify, rewrite) to an Ollama-native or OpenAI-compatible endpoint by file path, so the source text never enters the main model's context. Adds per-workspace local-AI levels (none/light/default/high/max) with a local_worker subagent, and an opt-in SlaveAgentTeams mode that runs parallel child agents on discovered local or cloud model routes.

scripts.test: node scripts/test-host.mjs && node scripts/test-client.mjs && node scripts/test-levels.mjs && node scripts/test-policy.mjs && node scripts/test-slaves.mjs && node scripts/test-regressions.mjs
